title: Rockefeller pressure leads the Clinton administration to look into Roswell
summary: James Fox tells of Rockefeller pressure leads the Clinton administration to look into Roswell, about 1990s at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: according to Podesta, Clinton was not happy with the answers they were getting. They were getting the runaround.

plain: A documentary filmmaker, James Fox, says that in the 1990s the wealthy philanthropist Lawrence Rockefeller pressed President Bill Clinton's White House to look into Roswell, the 1947 New Mexico event often said to involve a crashed UFO. According to Fox, John Podesta, a senior Clinton aide, told him Clinton was unhappy with the answers he got and felt he was being given the runaround. If true, it would mean even a sitting president could not get straight answers about UFOs from his own government.
